name: 3-Ingredient No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
desc: Vanilla ice cream made from whipped cream folded into sweetened condensed milk, no machine needed.

source.title: 3-Ingredient No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste (or vanilla extract)

steps: Put a 9x5 in metal loaf pan in the freezer to chill.
Whip the cream with a mixer on medium-high until stiff peaks form, 2-3 min.
In a large bowl, whisk the condensed milk and vanilla.
Fold about 1 cup of the whipped cream into the condensed milk to lighten it, then fold that mixture back into the rest of the cream until no streaks remain.
Scrape into the chilled pan, smooth the top, cover, and freeze at least 6 hr, until firm and scoopable.
tips: Food Network's version adds a pinch of fine salt, which sharpens the vanilla.

references.title: No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
references.usedFor: 9x5 in chilled metal loaf pan, lighten-then-fold method, whipping time
